announcements.title: Keep Aniraku online
announcements.banner: Massage from Dev cuase of recent down's of backend
body: I don't know if you're aware of the thing i mean some technical stuff.The thing is we were running in AWS Free credit VPS now we have 18$ left the thing is we charged for Bandwidth rather than System.So my request to you guys is than if you guys can then let Aniraku with your donation's even a few bucks would run aniraku a month.

As of now Aniraku has a large Amount of Growing Anime library and me as a dev trying to make it more bigger that isn't possible without you guys help.Tho guys who has github please give my project a star that would help me to get a sponserred VPS if i can make a decent amount of stars.Or give this little work a donation

If you know or not Aniraku was built for an ad-free anime streaming site rather than that you will find many site or apps what have ads to make it ad free i decrypt the embeded provider and re-proxy them so Aniraku can stream ad-free and That's what eat's the Bandwidth so i need your help to live as Aniraku is.
If Aniraku Ever helps you to watch an anime or ever make your day in any Way then Give Aniraku donation to maintain a VPS and also if you do have Github then consider giving my Little work a Star
